recipe.description: Suno servo motor; stable decoded 5.04-7.29s region, 65Hz highpass and 3.2kHz lowpass, 250ms crossfade into a sustaining two-second loop; runtime supplies pitch rise
Small two-stage metal selection latch with tiny glass pin
Terminal physical lock and upward crystalline ring for all six pieces
Suno six-piece release; immediate attack from decoded 0.437-0.717s over its own 1.30-2.43s body, body offset 18ms; removes lead-in and shortens the separate bloom to one 1.15-second release
Partial launch: compressed release mechanism, small energy edge and single metal snap
Short articulated mechanism sweep with a quiet localized air edge, no impact body
Heavy plate contact, weighted body blow and delayed irregular mineral debris
Firm ordinary armor hit: damped metal contact with mid-body knock
Defensive metal clash with a short ringing edge distinct from player damage
Successful perfect guard: crossed bright contact opening into a clean bronze harmonic tail
Compact movement servo and small dry pin, short enough to avoid a repeated wind wash
Returning mechanism winds toward three accelerating precision ratchet locks
Damped docking socket with a distinct second physical lock
Three indexed assembly clicks and a short bronze acquisition resonance
Muffled weighted body damage with a restrained armor-fracture edge
Hollow hostile resonator release, separated from the sharp player mechanism
Small ceramic and metal armor chip underneath confirmed player contact
Low strained hostile mechanism grows into a clear commitment click
Large threat: growing low resonator and three tightening uneven armor pulses
Weighted stone-machine collapse, loose plates and irregular mineral debris
Single low temple bell announcing commitment, no added background music
Restrained ascending bronze resonance for earned completion
Quiet real river-water bed, equal-gain crossfade into a continuous twelve-second loop
